intro: Where ideas meet structure, Sync tables support collaborative thinking. Designed to host productive meetings with integrated connectivity.

features.title: Understated Modern Design
features.text: Clean lines and neutral styling make it a versatile fit for a variety of office interiors—from collaborative zones to formal meeting rooms

features.title: Spacious Tabletop
features.text: Generously sized surface comfortably accommodates 6–10 users, perfect for team discussions and presentations.

features.title: Minimalist angled Legs
features.text: Angled metal legs provide strong support while giving the table a modern, open look.

features.title: Rounded Edges for Safety
features.text: Smooth, curved corners reduce sharp contact points and add a refined aesthetic.

features.title: Integrated Cable Access
features.text: Features a central access port with a sleek cover, allowing provisions for seamless power connectivity for meetings.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
